name: Bai Hongbiao
bio: In 1993, he won the National Newcomer Singing Competition Excellence Award. In 1999, he launched a personal single "New Hero Story", "Who Knows", "Little Woman", "Enjoy Lonely" as a singer. In 2003, the first vigilant drama "Conquest" was filmed. In 2006, he appeared in the revenge drama "Deepen Wine Lane". In 2009, he participated in the anti-Japanese war drama "Snow Leopard".
